hunks.before: group_id uuid; cycle_id uuid; member_ids uuid[]; n bigint;
hunks.after: group_id uuid; cycle_id uuid; cycle_ids uuid[]; member_ids uuid[]; n bigint;

hunks.before:
select g.id,cycle.id into strict group_id,cycle_id from public.weekly_source_groups g
  join public.weekly_source_group_clients member on member.source_group_id=g.id and member.client_id=c.client_id
   and t.week_ending_date between member.valid_from and coalesce(member.valid_to,'infinity'::date)
  join public.weekly_source_cycles cycle on cycle.source_group_id=g.id and cycle.finalisation_week_ending=t.week_ending_date
  where g.active and g.environment='TEST' and g.source_family='ROSTER';
